title: This is a must do!
text: One of the most fun experiences my family and I had in Barcelona! Val made us feel like superstars while capturing amazing photos throughout this beautiful city. Definitely a must-do while in Barcelona!

text: Nati was fantastic to work with! She took so many shots and we had so many to choose from. We went through the Gothic Quarter, through a park, and the famous Kiss Wall. I would highly recommend booking this photo shoot!
author: vanessacE2441WP

title: July (heat wave) tour
text:
I scheduled a photo tour with Val back in May. She was very prompt with her emails.
As the date was approaching, a big heat wave came through Spain and I considered canceling because I thought my kids might not last. The day of the tour, Val had great communication and we found her right away in front of the cathedral. She interacted great with my 3 kids (ages 9,6&6). Despite the heat, she managed to get some great smiles out of them and captured my family beautifully. Also, the tour was great. Just the right speed for  kids. I would highly recommend her.
author: 165nataliea

title: Private Family Photoshoot in Barcelona
